items.text: A 404 from commentOnIssue or updateIssueComment reads as 'missing', never as 'no_permission'. issueRefusalOf maps not_found to 'missing' unless details.reason is no_permission (packages/capabilities/src/githost/types.ts:265-277), and only createIssue probes the repository to set that reason. w8-issue-host's fix-up left it this way on purpose, because on these routes a 404 can also mean a deleted comment or issue. The status writer is the only caller, so its reviewer checks the following. On 'missing' right after a read, the writer re-reads the issue and its own comment before it writes again. It recreates its comment only when the issue is readable and the comment is gone (W8-write-8). It never opens a second issue or a second comment because an edit answered 404. It says the no-permission sentence when the re-read is refused. Done: two status-board cases on the stand-in. In the first, updateIssueComment answers 404 for a token that has lost access: there is one issue, no new comment, and the no-permission sentence. In the second, the comment was deleted: exactly one comment is recreated.
